1.consolidated_definition: dep. Derribo. Sigla anglicada, frecuente. Véase nocaut. Hoy jueves, se celebró la conferencia de prensa y el primer pre-pesaje oficial, previo a la cartelera de boxeo del 17 de junio del 2006, denominada Noche de padres, que se llevará cabo en el Coliseo Pedrín Zorrilla de Hato Rey, que tendrá como atractivo principal el choque entre el invicto mini mosca boricua Omar Pastor Soto y el mexicano Juan Alfonso Keb-Bass , además de la semi estelar entre José Carita López, quien ostenta record de 32 victorias con 29 KO y el colombiano Pedro Torito Rincón (Municipio de San Juan, 18-05-06)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Derribo (K.O.). Abbreviated term, frequently used. See knockout. On Thursday, a press conference and the first official weigh-in took place prior to the boxing card on June 17, 2006, titled "Noche de padres" (Parents' Night), which will be held at the Pedrín Zorrilla Coliseum in Hato Rey, featuring as its main attraction the clash between undefeated mini flyweight Omar Pastor Soto from Puerto Rico and Juan Alfonso Keb-Bass from Mexico, as well as the semi-main event between José Carita López, who holds a record of 32 wins with 29 knockouts, and Pedro Torito Rincón from Colombia (San Juan Municipality, May 18, 2006).
